englishTitle: Branch Expansion and Compression Transition Study 1 — Prospective exact analysis of longitudinal bounded local game-tree geometry change, transition onset, persistence, reopening, and reversal along Bao trajectories
japaneseTitle: Baoにおけるbranch expansion / compression転移のprospective exact解析 — 対局trajectory上のbounded局所ゲーム木幾何の変化、転移開始、持続、再開放、反転の再現可能な検証

canonicalSerialization.crossImplementationEquality: SHA-256 equality of canonical scientific content; incidental JavaScript prototype/insertion/runtime identity excluded

BECT-M3-GLOBAL-DISTINCT-RAW-STATES.value: global distinct RAW states over relative depths 0..5

BECT-M4-CUMULATIVE-TREE-RAW-RATIO.denominator: global distinct RAW states over relative depths 0..5

BECT-M5-DUPLICATE-TRANSITION-FRACTION.numerator: sum duplicate encounter count over parent depths 0..4
BECT-M5-DUPLICATE-TRANSITION-FRACTION.denominator: sum tree edge/transition occurrences over parent depths 0..4

BECT-M7-BRANCH-REOPENING-FRACTION.denominator: sum classified reply-width transition counts, parent depths 0..4

BECT-M8-BRANCH-EXTINCTION-FRACTION.denominator: sum classified reply-width transition counts, parent depths 0..4

transitionGrammar.level: L_m(t) is the exact endpoint value at source trajectory ply t
transitionGrammar.adjacentDelta: D_m(t)=L_m(t+1)-L_m(t) as an exact reduced rational
transitionGrammar.onsetUp: D_m(t)>0 and previous defined delta D_m(t-1)<=0
transitionGrammar.onsetDown: D_m(t)<0 and previous defined delta D_m(t-1)>=0
transitionGrammar.persistenceUp: an onsetUp at t followed by defined D_m(t+1)>0
transitionGrammar.persistenceDown: an onsetDown at t followed by defined D_m(t+1)<0
transitionGrammar.reversalAfterUp: an onsetUp at t followed by defined D_m(t+1)<0
transitionGrammar.reversalAfterDown: an onsetDown at t followed by defined D_m(t+1)>0
transitionGrammar.stallAfterOnset: onset followed by defined zero delta
transitionGrammar.recovery: two consecutive nonzero deltas with opposite signs after an onset; reported separately from persistence
transitionGrammar.thresholdPolicy: no magnitude threshold in the frozen Stage 1 grammar; exact sign only
transitionGrammar.phaseBoundaryPrimaryRule: any delta or three-delta event window whose source states include more than one rule phase is excluded from primary transition inference
transitionGrammar.phaseContextRule: rule phase may be attached only after geometry events are constructed; phase labels are contextual and not event ground truth

trajectoryPolicy.selection: source seed ascending; first N eligible trajectories

experimentalUnit.withinTrajectoryRepeatedMeasures: ordered roots, adjacent-root pairs and event windows are dependent repeated observations
experimentalUnit.formalAggregation: candidate-specific persistence-minus-reversal balance is reduced to one sign per trajectory

stage1Promotion.candidateIdentity: metric ID + onset direction (UP or DOWN)
stage1Promotion.coverage: all 10 trajectories have defined level series for the candidate metric over all primary-eligible windows needed for its observed onsets
stage1Promotion.onsetPrevalenceGate: at least 6 of 10 trajectories contain >=1 primary-eligible onset of the frozen direction
stage1Promotion.trajectoryBalance: persistent event count minus reversal event count for that candidate/direction within one trajectory; stalls excluded from sign
stage1Promotion.nonZeroBalanceGate: at least 6 trajectories have nonzero trajectory balance
stage1Promotion.dominantPersistenceGate: at least two thirds of nonzero trajectory balances are positive
stage1Promotion.promotion: coverage + onset prevalence + nonzero balance + dominant persistence gates all pass

stage2FormalValidation.onsetPrevalenceGate: at least 10 of 16 trajectories contain >=1 primary-eligible onset of the frozen direction
stage2FormalValidation.nonZeroBalanceGate: at least 10 trajectories have nonzero persistence-minus-reversal balance
stage2FormalValidation.directionGate: positive trajectory balance must be the dominant nonzero sign
stage2FormalValidation.test: exact two-sided sign test on nonzero trajectory-level persistence-minus-reversal balances
stage2FormalValidation.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise alpha 1/20 across the frozen promoted set
stage2FormalValidation.candidateConfirmation: coverage + onset prevalence + nonzero balance + persistence direction + sequential Holm gate all pass

resourceCeilings.resourceFailure: fail closed as NON-ESTIMABLE or TECHNICAL-INVALID according to whether the scientific content was validly measured before the frozen ceiling failure; no seed extension/root replacement

noRescue.boundary: first fresh scientific generation or read, whichever is earlier
